preconditions.description: Input constraints for n (data centers), m (clients), and h (hours per day) must be satisfied.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(u) < int(h) for u in u_list.split())
preconditions.description: Each maintenance hour u_j must be in the range [0, h-1].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(c1) <= int(n) and 1 <= int(c2) <= int(n) and int(c1) != int(c2) for c1, c2 in client_pairs)
preconditions.description: Each client pair (c_{i,1}, c_{i,2}) must consist of two distinct data center indices within the valid range.
The number of maintenance hours must match n, and the number of client pairs must match m.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= (int(u) + 1) % int(h) < int(h) for u in selected_u) and len(selected_u) == int(k)
postconditions.description: The selected data centers' maintenance hours are shifted by one hour (mod h), and k is the count of selected data centers.

postconditions.expression: all((int(u_list[c1 - 1]) != (int(u_list[c2 - 1]) + 1) % int(h)) and (int(u_list[c2 - 1]) != (int(u_list[c1 - 1]) + 1) % int(h)) for c1, c2 in client_pairs)
postconditions.description: For every client pair, the original maintenance hours of their data centers are not equal to each other's shifted hours (mod h).

postconditions.expression: all((int(u_list[c1 - 1]) != (int(u_list[c2 - 1]) + 1) % int(h)) and (int(u_list[c2 - 1]) != (int(u_list[c1 - 1]) + 1) % int(h)) for c1, c2 in client_pairs if c1 in selected_indices and c2 in selected_indices)
postconditions.description: For every client pair where both data centers are selected, their shifted maintenance hours are not equal.

postconditions.expression: all((int(u_list[c1 - 1]) != (int(u_list[c2 - 1]) + 1) % int(h)) or (int(u_list[c2 - 1]) != (int(u_list[c1 - 1]) + 1) % int(h)) for c1, c2 in client_pairs)
postconditions.description: For every client pair, at least one of the following holds: the original maintenance hours are not equal to each other's shifted hours (mod h).

postconditions.expression: 1 <= int(k) <= int(n) and all(1 <= int(x) <= int(n) for x in selected_indices)
postconditions.description: The output k is a valid count of selected data centers, and the selected indices are within the valid range.
